exact_statement: For every integer d>=1, a Boolean sign on disjoint uniform physical X,Y cubes whose distinct X Fourier labels S_j have size <=d and whose partial rows are unit quadratic signs on affine Y partition cells A_j of codimension k_j has H(S_Y|S_X)=sum_j 2^(-k_j)(k_j+r_j)<=2 I_Y, H(S_X)=sum_j 2^(-k_j)k_j, and H(f)=sum_j 2^(-k_j)(2k_j+r_j)<=4 I_Y, where r_j is the quadratic polar rank restricted to the direction space of A_j. Admission is stable under every coordinate Y restriction and X restrictions preserving injective projected labels. Every admitted Boolean tensor factor on fresh Y bits is a quadratic phase. Full physical restriction closure of unbounded ordinary addressing contains every Boolean sign, so a conditional bound on that closure is FEI-strength.
